manualGateSequence.name: read_only_account_restriction_check
manualGateSequence.condition: Run only on explicit request or when user observes restriction disappearing
manualGateSequence.requirement: Authenticated read-only form actually visible, no warning, 202/401/403/429 or challenge

manualGateSequence.name: new_notifications_review
manualGateSequence.requirement: Check recent TheTVDB moderation notices, confirm no new blocking messages

manualGateSequence.name: offline_integrity_check
manualGateSequence.requirement: Exactly 192 originals, 25 locked refusals, 1 Raska held, source hashes intact

manualGateSequence.name: single_canary_source_and_episode_check
manualGateSequence.requirement: Visual/editorial review at full size, present-day episode ID/title/channel link and missing artwork proof, selected file hash unchanged

manualGateSequence.name: single_canary_upload_with_explicit_new_approval
manualGateSequence.requirement: Separate reviewed unlocking commit and explicit fresh user go-ahead ONLY after all checks; one episode

manualGateSequence.name: site_persistence_and_duplicate_postcheck
manualGateSequence.requirement: Positive acceptance on TheTVDB with visible proper episode image, no duplicate, no moderator warning

manualGateSequence.name: gradual_further_uploads
manualGateSequence.requirement: New user instruction and full individual controls for every image; never auto-launch 192-image wave

hazardList: Any account upload restriction message or absent form
Selected original variant replaced without user's explicit choice
Any of the 25 AUCUNE_IMAGE_ADAPTEE entered pipeline
Wrong episode identity/title, thumbnail derived from wrong video
Watermark, subtitle, title card, unrelated brand or timer
File hash changed from pinned original SHA256
Any unexpected POST, crop or upload confirmation mismatch
